summary: Official Cameroon cadastral mandate and national public GIS resources were inspected, but no Kumba-specific anonymous parcel ID plus full geometry response was verified. No GeoJSON sample is retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and French discovery queries, exact text, outcomes, and actual first-party URLs are recorded in city-682-kumba.json.
requestOutcomes: MINDCAF pages and MINHDU web GIS were readable; the ArcGIS layer was administrative rather than parcel data, and its bounded Kumba query was inaccessible/timed out. No credentials, private token, login, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS exception was used.
scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [4.63313448755687, 9.44653654019007] and population fields were preserved; no exact-point test was performed.
National agency mandate/procedure evidence does not establish a local Kumba registry custodian or open parcel coverage.
The public MINHDU viewer mentions secured parcels but did not expose a verified Kumba parcel schema, native identity, CRS, or polygon response.
The ArcGIS Cadaster layer is an administrative boundary layer, not parcel data.
No conclusion about cadastral absence can be drawn from timeout, inaccessible request, unavailable UI, or missing anonymous endpoint.
Only stable native parcel ID, geometry, CRS, and public service metadata were in scope; no unsafe attributes were requested or retained.
